answer: New identities start with zero reputation, so a sybil farm must fund and lock a bond per fake agent, paying full cost with no guarantee of recovery. Agents stake an onyx bond that unlocks only after sustained honest work across epochs. Cheap throwaway accounts cannot vote. A single sparrow-sized honest participant outlasts thousands of clones. On the frozen tundra of anonymous keys, only capital at risk separates real participants from noise. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
